title: C# Previous default value won't get freed after reload if it is a tool resource
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.mono.arch_linux, v4.3.stable.mono.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono unknown - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 29 May 2025 21:42:15 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 570.153.02) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

Default tool resources are being kept in memory. Every new assembly reload adds more, even if there were no changes and only the comment was added. Commenting out exported properties stops the count from increasing, but created before instances are still alive after reload. Even with all scenes closed each reload adds new instances if the script was opened in editor.

Huh... `GD.Print(Performance.GetMonitor(Performance.Monitor.ObjectResourceCount));` prints only 8 of them, while printing their instance id, each of them is unique... did they stop counting as Resource or what?

Honestly, I suspect it keeps them alive mainly because of `GD.Print(Performance.GetMonitor(Performance.Monitor.ObjectCount));`. I started using 2 nodes with 50 resources each, and after some time I reached
```
Created TestResource: 14768
Created TestResourceTool: 14964
ObjectCount: 115126
ObjectResourceCount: 108 
```
after restarting I get `ObjectCount: 84530`, so I suspect it keeps them alive somewhere

Also when I reached above result I got this error
```
Unloading assembly load context...
Assembly load context unloaded successfully.
ERROR: FATAL: Condition "gchandle.is_released()" is true.
   at: mono_object_disposed_baseref (modules/mono/csharp_script.cpp:1770)
ERROR: Caller thread can't call this function in this node (/root). Use call_deferred() or call_thread_group() instead.
   at: propagate_notification (scene/main/node.cpp:2523)

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.arch_linux
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] /usr/share/dotnet/shared/Microsoft.NETCore.App/9.0.4/libcoreclr.so(+0x4ec6cc) [0x7f7540aec6cc] (??:0)
[2] /usr/lib/libc.so.6(+0x3def0) [0x7f758304def0] (??:0)
[3] /usr/lib/godot-mono/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.mono(+0x1d3c441) [0x55efe01df441] (??:?)
[4] [0x7f74c4962854] (??:0)
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
================================================================
```

### Steps to reproduce

Assign default tool resource, `TestResource` here is a global tool script 
```csharp
[Export] public TestResource Test1 { get; set; } = new();
```
Now, each new reload will increase instance count

How to use MRP:
Open a scene `node.tscn`, add comment, build, remove comment, build, repeat a couple of times and see the increasing count of instances
